name: mds-epd
description: Real questions against the MDS_EPD pharmacy distribution ERP in English, Urdu and Roman Urdu. 'natural' cases are phrased the way users talk, with no column hints. Gold SQL verified by hand; dates are absolute.

cases.question: How many customers do we have?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM dbo.Customer

cases.question: How many customers are marked as deleted?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Customer WHERE del = 1

cases.question: How many customers are in the retail category (code R)?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Customer WHERE catagory = 'R'

cases.question: How many invoices were made in 2026?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= '2026-01-01' AND inv_date < '2027-01-01'

cases.question: Total net invoice amount (net_amt) per year.
cases.gold: SELECT YEAR(inv_date) AS Yr, SUM(net_amt) AS NetSales FROM dbo.InvoiceLine GROUP BY YEAR(inv_date)

cases.question: Net sales (sum of invoice net_amt) for each month of 2026, as month number and amount.
cases.gold: SELECT MONTH(inv_date) AS Mon, SUM(net_amt) AS NetSales FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= '2026-01-01' AND inv_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(inv_date)

cases.question: Which month number of 2026 had the highest net sales (invoice net_amt)?
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 1 MONTH(inv_date) AS Mon FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= '2026-01-01' AND inv_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(inv_date) ORDER BY SUM(net_amt) DESC

cases.question: Top 5 companies by net sales, using invoice detail total_net.
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 5 c.comp_name, SUM(d.total_net) AS NetSales FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail d JOIN dbo.Company c ON c.comp_id = d.comp_id GROUP BY c.comp_name ORDER BY NetSales DESC

cases.question: Top 3 booking men by total invoice net amount.
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 3 b.bName, SUM(i.net_amt) AS NetSales FROM dbo.InvoiceLine i JOIN dbo.BookingMan b ON b.bId = i.bId GROUP BY b.bName ORDER BY NetSales DESC

cases.question: Which 5 areas have the most customers? Give area name and customer count.
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 5 a.name, COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM dbo.Customer c JOIN dbo.TblArea a ON a.area_id = c.area_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY Customers DESC

cases.question: How many products are there?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Product

cases.question: How many products have zero stock?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Product WHERE stock = 0

cases.question: Total cash received from customers (sum of amt).
cases.gold: SELECT SUM(amt) FROM dbo.CashRecieved

cases.question: Total net purchase amount across all purchase invoices.
cases.gold: SELECT SUM(netamount) FROM dbo.PurchaseLine

cases.question: Total net amount of sales returns.
cases.gold: SELECT SUM(netamount) FROM dbo.SalesReturnLine

cases.question: Top 5 products by quantity sold (sale_qty), with product name.
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 5 p.name, SUM(d.sale_qty) AS Qty FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail d JOIN dbo.Product p ON p.comp_id = d.comp_id AND p.group_id = d.group_id AND p.prod_id = d.prod_id GROUP BY p.comp_id, p.group_id, p.prod_id, p.name ORDER BY Qty DESC

cases.question: What is the average invoice net amount?
cases.gold: SELECT AVG(net_amt) FROM dbo.InvoiceLine

cases.question: How many stock batches that still have quantity expire before 1 October 2026?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.StockDetail WHERE qty > 0 AND expdate < '2026-10-01'

cases.question: How many customers have never been invoiced?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.InvoiceLine i WHERE i.cust_id = c.cust_id)

cases.question: How many invoices come from each invoice source?
cases.gold: SELECT inv_src, COUNT(*) FROM dbo.InvoiceLine GROUP BY inv_src

cases.question: ہمارے کتنے گاہک ہیں؟
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM dbo.Customer

cases.question: 2026 میں کتنی انوائسز بنیں؟
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= '2026-01-01' AND inv_date < '2027-01-01'

cases.question: کل انوائس نیٹ رقم کے لحاظ سے ٹاپ 3 بکنگ مین کون ہیں؟
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 3 b.bName, SUM(i.net_amt) AS NetSales FROM dbo.InvoiceLine i JOIN dbo.BookingMan b ON b.bId = i.bId GROUP BY b.bName ORDER BY NetSales DESC

cases.question: کتنی پروڈکٹس کا اسٹاک صفر ہے؟
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Product WHERE stock = 0

cases.question: گاہکوں سے کل کتنی نقد رقم وصول ہوئی؟
cases.gold: SELECT SUM(amt) FROM dbo.CashRecieved

cases.question: کن 5 علاقوں میں سب سے زیادہ گاہک ہیں؟ علاقے کا نام اور گاہکوں کی تعداد بتائیں۔
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 5 a.name, COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM dbo.Customer c JOIN dbo.TblArea a ON a.area_id = c.area_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY Customers DESC

cases.question: کتنی کمپنیاں ہیں؟
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Company

cases.question: 2026 کے کس مہینے (نمبر) میں انوائس نیٹ سیل سب سے زیادہ تھی؟
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 1 MONTH(inv_date) AS Mon FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= '2026-01-01' AND inv_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(inv_date) ORDER BY SUM(net_amt) DESC

cases.question: hamare kitne customers hain?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM dbo.Customer

cases.question: kitni products hain?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Product

cases.question: sales return ki total net amount kitni hai?
cases.gold: SELECT SUM(netamount) FROM dbo.SalesReturnLine

cases.question: kitne towns hain?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.TblTown

cases.question: total_net ke hisab se top 5 companies konsi hain?
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 5 c.comp_name, SUM(d.total_net) AS NetSales FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail d JOIN dbo.Company c ON c.comp_id = d.comp_id GROUP BY c.comp_name ORDER BY NetSales DESC

cases.question: average invoice net amount kya hai?
cases.gold: SELECT AVG(net_amt) FROM dbo.InvoiceLine

cases.question: 2026 mein sab se zyada sale kis mahine mein hui?
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 1 MONTH(inv_date) AS Mon FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= '2026-01-01' AND inv_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(inv_date) ORDER BY SUM(net_amt) DESC

cases.question: top 3 booking man kon hain net sale ke hisab se?
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 3 b.bName, SUM(i.net_amt) AS NetSales FROM dbo.InvoiceLine i JOIN dbo.BookingMan b ON b.bId = i.bId GROUP BY b.bName ORDER BY NetSales DESC

cases.question: 2026 mein sab se zyada bikne wali 5 products (units)?
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 5 p.name, SUM(d.sale_qty) AS Qty FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail d JOIN dbo.InvoiceLine i ON i.inv_no = d.inv_no JOIN dbo.Product p ON p.comp_id = d.comp_id AND p.group_id = d.group_id AND p.prod_id = d.prod_id WHERE i.inv_date >= '2026-01-01' AND i.inv_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY p.comp_id, p.group_id, p.prod_id, p.name ORDER BY Qty DESC

cases.question: sab se zyada udhaar kis area ke customers par hai?
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 1 a.name, SUM(c.cust_rec_balance) AS Due FROM dbo.Customer c JOIN dbo.TblArea a ON a.area_id = c.area_id GROUP BY a.area_id, a.name ORDER BY Due DESC

cases.question: Which company's products sold the most units in 2026?
cases.gold: SELECT TOP 1 c.comp_name, SUM(d.sale_qty) AS Units FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail d JOIN dbo.InvoiceLine i ON i.inv_no = d.inv_no JOIN dbo.Company c ON c.comp_id = d.comp_id WHERE i.inv_date >= '2026-01-01' AND i.inv_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY c.comp_id, c.comp_name ORDER BY Units DESC

cases.question: 2026 میں ہر مہینے کی کل سیل کتنی رہی؟
cases.gold: SELECT MONTH(inv_date) AS Mon, SUM(net_amt) AS NetSales FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= '2026-01-01' AND inv_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(inv_date)
